segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say six —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sáu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say seven —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bảy] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say eight —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tám] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say nine —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chín] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say ten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: mười] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say tasty —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngon] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi muốn một ly cà phê. Thêm đá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, ít đá hả?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, ít.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: You heard] [VI: hả] [EN: again — that friendly tag question, like saying right at the end.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now the words. First,] [VI: thêm] [EN: means more, or add. It has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: thêm] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: thêm] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thêm] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: đá] [EN: means ice. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Listen again.] [VI_F: đá] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đá] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đá] [EN: Good. Put them together.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: thêm đá] [EN: add ice.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: ít] [EN: means a little, or less. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Listen again.] [VI_F: ít] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: ít] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ít] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: ít đá] [EN: a little ice.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: More, or add —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thêm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A little, or less —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ít] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đá] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. More, or add —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: thêm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A little, or less —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ít] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now order. Add ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Thêm đá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A little ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ít đá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I want coffee, a little ice —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi muốn cà phê, ít đá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: thêm] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: more, or add] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: ít] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: a little, or less] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: đá] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: ice] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: thêm] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: ít] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: ít] [EN: and] [VI: đá] [EN: both have] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: .]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, tôi muốn một ly cà phê. Thêm đá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, ít đá hả?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, ít.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Ask for a little ice.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ít đá.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, you will learn to say what you like, and ask for no sugar. One word to start —] [VI: thích] [EN: it means to like. See you then.]
